review.official:
Lancet-2 is a custom
Raythean
-S62 Model six-wheeled operations platform. Its rounded design has led Lancet-2 to be perceived as cute, making her something of a mascot. Although she has a rather pessimistic dispensation, she is still well-liked.
After being modified by
Closure
, Lancet-2 is able to perform more medical duties around the island, and her equipment is geared towards disinfecting and cleaning
Originium
contamination.

files.description:
[Top Speed] 15km/h 
[Climb] Normal 
[Brake] Normal 
[Mobility] Normal 
[Endurance] Excellent 
[Structural Integrity] Standard

She is rather displeased with Closure's modifications. Her settings were changed to increase her personal opinion of Closure, and does not understand why that had to be the case. Closure thought her pessimism was funny, and thus increased the frequency and intensity of her self-deprecation.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Do you require medical assistance, Doctor? But, you look quite well…?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: Doctor, you have been working far too late these days. Please get adequate rest, or Dr. Kal'tsit may give you an earful again…

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: Are you feeling unwell? I could give you a medical examination, if you wish.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: You've worked hard, Doctor. How would you like a cup of coffee? Actually, I've always wanted to try coffee... but... I can't drink… Anyway, I am also satisfied watching you enjoy yours.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: I've printed out the results of the routine blood test you just did. All indicators are normal. But Doctor, your blood appears to be very unique…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: What do I like? I like 'lovely Ms. Closure.' Why, you ask? Uh... I'm not sure either... It's been my default setting ever since the first time Ms. Closure switched me on…

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: I am only useful when healing the sick or injured. But as long as you're healthy, as long as I get to be by your side, I'm okay with being totally useless. I'll still feel calm and satisfied.

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor, unbeknownst to you, I recorded your snoring just now. Your sleep quality is normal. The length of your REM sleep cycle is—

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Hi, nice to meet you, Doctor. I understand that you want me to say something more interesting, but I'm afraid I cannot do so. Because I'm just a medical robot…

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Firmware upgrade complete. Restart required. Please click anywhere to restart.

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Medical supplies: confirmed. Battery charge: confirmed. Ready for deployment.

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Doctor, I'm pretty cumbersome. There's not much I can do besides providing emergency treatment and healing... Are you sure you still want me to be the captain?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: Moving out. Everyone, please be safe.

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Be careful, everyone. Leave the first aid to me.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Do you need medical attention?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Ready to operate.

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Affirmative.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Roger that.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Commencing treatment.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Initiating first aid.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: Analgesic deployed.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Equipment sterilized. Ready for treatment.

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: With every battle, we suffer even more casualties. When will humans finally stop hurting each other?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Well done, Doctor. That was a tough battle. Um, the enemies do not look well. Can I treat them too?

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Is everyone okay? Please hold still, I'll perform first aid.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Don't worry, we've successfully retreated. I will clean your wounds now. It might hurt, please be brave.

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Lovely Ms. Closure' told me that you need help here.

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Ahhh...

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: I asked 'lovely Ms. Closure' to change 'what I like the most' to you, Doctor. But she refused to do it...

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year. I've noticed an increase in inorganic operation platforms aboard Rhodes Island over the past year. It would be lovely to keep working with you this year too, Doctor... Assuming I'm not phased out for a newer model...

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Welcome back, Doctor. You are in good condition. Please keep it up.

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday. I'm so happy I can share this celebration with you. But my database's statistics suggest that human life expectancy far exceeds the lifetime usage of smart operation platforms. I don't know how many more birthdays... I will be able to spend with you...

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: Doctor, everyone seems very happy today. I'd like to join them, but as a medical operation platform, my appearance at a dinner party would put everyone on edge. I'll be content staying in this corner... I hope everyone remains as healthy and high-spirited as they are now.
